unifiedextensionforfemiwiki-growthexperi: {{SITENAME}} is built by people like {{GENDER:|you}} working together.
{{GENDER:|Your}} edits help improve {{SITENAME}} and further the mission to share free knowledge with the world. Continue to start with small suggested edits.
Help add to the world's knowledge with some easy fixes on {{SITENAME}} articles.
Help add to the world's knowledge with some easy fixes on {{SITENAME}} articles.
When {{GENDER:$1|you}} have learned about {{SITENAME}} best practices.

Copy editing is about making a small fix to the way an article is written, and it is a valuable and easy way to get used to editing {{SITENAME}}. Copy edits help articles be more professional and trustworthy.
Use books, websites, and news sources to validate that {{SITENAME}} is accurate, and add those to articles so that readers can feel confident that what they're reading is true.
Articles get out of date as time goes on and new events occur. Find and add the correct information so that {{SITENAME}} always contains the current truth.
Many {{SITENAME}} articles are only a sentence or two long. Find more information and add it to make the article more complete.
communityconfiguration-femiwikisuggested: Topics newcomers can choose suggested edits from. A topic matches the articles in any of its categories.
Topics selected for users who have not chosen any
writemanualnotification-text: Sends a notification to every registered user, or to the members of one group. Users who turned off "{{int:echo-category-title-write-manual-notification}}" in their notification preferences do not receive it, and email goes only to those who turned it on. Delivery runs in the background, one batch of users at a time.
writemanualnotification-help-page: Clicking the notification opens this page.
writemanualnotification-confirm: This notification will go to {{PLURAL:$1|one user|$1 users}} ($2). Check the preview above, then press "{{int:writemanualnotification-send}}". Changing anything shows a new preview first.
writemanualnotification-no-recipients: No user would receive this notification.
writemanualnotification-busy: Another notification is being sent right now. Try again in a minute.
writemanualnotification-duplicate: The same notification was already sent to the same recipients in the last 24 hours.
writemanualnotification-bad-page: The linked page is not valid.
writemanualnotification-too-long: The title can be at most $1 characters long and the body at most $2.
writemanualnotification-queued: The notification is queued for {{PLURAL:$1|one user|$1 users}}. It is delivered in the background, which can take a few minutes. See [[Special:Log/manualnotification]].
echo-pref-tooltip-write-manual-notificat: Notify me when administrators send a notification to all users or to a group. It may be an announcement or a promotion.
right-writemanualnotification: Send a notification to all users or to a group
action-writemanualnotification: send a notification to all users or to a group
log-description-manualnotification: Notifications that administrators sent to all users or to a group with [[Special:WriteManualNotification]].
logentry-manualnotification-all: $1 {{GENDER:$2|sent}} the notification "$4", linking to $3, to all users ({{PLURAL:$5|one user|$5 users}})
logentry-manualnotification-group: $1 {{GENDER:$2|sent}} the notification "$4", linking to $3, to the group $6 ({{PLURAL:$5|one user|$5 users}})
